title: secp256k1-ecdlp: Pollard's rho with bounded distinguished points (rho-v2)

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P on secp256k1, the Pollard's rho algorithm with distinguished-point density 2^{-32}, at most 2^{16} concurrent walks, a hard cap of 2^{129.2} reference operations per trial, and an eviction/restart policy recovers x with success probability at least 0.39. Total charged work is at most 2^{129.2} target-group-operation equivalents (C=1000). Peak memory is at most 2^{30} bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^{16}. No negation map is used. Heuristics are disclosed in proof.md. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice.

experiments.purpose: Simulate Pollard's rho collision finding and discrete-log recovery on a small cyclic group. Confirms control flow and birthday scaling only; does not establish production costs or field-arithmetic bounds.
